claim: The classic renderer decides which wall is in front by products of wall coordinates that overflow 32 bits for very long walls far apart: with sea bands one wall wide, everything past about 38 plan units was drawn under the water in the observer. DWE3M4's longest wall is 71,943.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:2227 wallfront (dmulscale2 into int32); the same in xmapedit/src/engine.c, seen in the XMapEdit observer run of the harbour
use: Cut big water and ground sectors so no wall is longer than the campaign's longest (about 72k).
